summary: @servicetitan/cp-api preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (pinned v1.3.13), extracts the platform-specific bun binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` at the package root during `npm install`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using a rotated string-array obfuscation scheme (`WV8StW` rotation, `_0xNNNN`/`MmgoCP` hex-token identifiers) so all API calls, hostnames, and file paths are reconstructed at runtime and not statically readable. The executed payload is not declared in the package's own `files` manifest (`"files": ["dist", "src"]`), yet ships at the tarball root — the payload arrives outside the author-declared publish surface. The `dist/` contents advertised by the package are trivial TypeScript/axios helpers that have no dependency on Bun. Installing this version fetches a secondary runtime and runs an opaque, obfuscated blob under it during npm install lifecycle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
